_comment: xp_wellys_atc - per-airport overrides (generic). Supplements Navigraph/apt.dat/atc.dat with hand-maintained per-ICAO data. Covers: (1) runway-in-use config (arrival/departure runways, wind-gated), (2) preferred approach by weather, (3) additional airport info (delegated controllers + freqs, AFIS/Tower names). Loaded from <plugin>/Resources/airport+.json. LOADER NOT BUILT YET (v4.4.0). Schema is PROVISIONAL - confirm before wiring.

runway_config: ordered, first match wins. {arrival, departure, max_tailwind_kt?, wind_min_dir?, wind_max_dir?}. arrival/departure may differ and be opposite. no wind field = always.
approaches: arrival-only. {runway, designator, min_vis_m?, max_vis_m?, min_ceiling_ft?, max_ceiling_ft?, min_rvr_m?}. first match (in file order) whose weather gates hold wins. gates use the DESTINATION METAR (dest_visibility_m / dest_ceiling_ft / per-runway RVR), not local DataRef.
controllers: additional airport info: controllers/freqs missing from atc.dat. {role, name, freq_mhz}. role = approach|tower|ground|delivery|atis|info.
departure_holds: SID climb shaping (local procedure not in CIFP/airspace). ordered, first whose match_fixes contains the SID exit fix wins; empty/absent match_fixes = any SID from this field. {match_fixes?, hold_alt_ft, release_nm?, step2_alt_ft?}. OVERRIDES the generic data-driven step1 / 10-NM hold. omitted fields keep the generic default (e.g. step2 stays the generic FL140). still clamped: step1 never below a SID fix min; step2 skipped if >= cruise.

departure_holds._comment: Annecy: hold FL110 for 30 NM. Verified airspace.txt along the ROMA2A (BELUS->GIRED) track: the Geneva TMA S10 sliver ends ~27.5 NM GC out, so 30 NM lands the handoff ~2.5 NM inside LYON CTA -> hands to Lyon 120.230, not the Geneva sliver. FL140 second step stays generic.

controllers.name: Milan Radar
controllers._comment: Torino Caselle departures worked by Milan Radar (ACC). The controlling volume above TORINO CTR (ceiling 3500) is MILAN CTA ZONE 24 in airspace.txt. Freq 129.275 per Navigraph (Torino ACC = MILAN RADAR 125.275 / 129.275). The sim atc.dat has Milan but with STALE freqs (MILAN ctr 118.675, MILAN RADAR tracon 126.750) that do not match Navigraph -- Navigraph updates nav+airspace, not atc.dat -- so this override injects the correct freq. Alt sector freq 125.275: switch here if 129.275 is the wrong Torino dep sector. Verified Navigraph 2026-07-27.
